scope: Bilingual food and farming authoring fragment only. Selected archives and repository defaults inspected read-only. No loaded registry, game launch, effective merged recipe manager or gameplay assertion.
tag_policy: Recipe tags remain alternative ingredient groups. Native icons show one accepted representative, not an exhaustive tag membership list. Compound ingredients show an accepted example and alternatives. Difference ingredients preserve their exclusion.
catalog_policy: All previously named entries in the six food catalogs retained. Each is explained as a recipe output, ingredient use, acquisition source, serving or container. No complete loaded edible-item total claimed. First grids identify catalog entries, second grids identify recipe inputs and containers.

findings: History is consumption-based with trackCount 16 from repository defaults. Recency decay multiplies food diversity by one minus age divided by trackCount plus one.
Duplicates use the maximum remaining contribution per item, not a sum of repeated distinct foods.
Shipped detriments array is empty. Shipped inventory diet button default is true. Repository does not override either setting.
No effective reward, food-property or food-stack-limit dump was collected.
